decisions.summary: bundled-scope justification: kernel extraction plus its two adopter sites ship as one PR
decisions.reason: The progress-deadline kernel and its graphify/verification-runner adopters are a single semantic decision: the kernel's semantics (monotonic-progress-only extension, independent hard caps, structured kill causes) are only proven correct by adopters exercising them against real child processes, and shipping the kernel alone would leave the two known-unbounded subprocess sites (story diagnose hang, timed_out misattribution) unfixed for another cycle. Remaining adopters (pr-manager autopilot shell, performance-measurer, independent-review-orchestrator) and lint-based recurrence prevention are explicitly split into followup stories per the Story's Out of Scope section. Review ownership is a single reviewer lane over six source files with the gate_evidence role covering evidence integrity.
